name: Vardenafil
description: Small-molecule PDE5 inhibitor taken by mouth; first sold as Levitra and Staxyn

note.text: FDA found Levitra and Staxyn were not discontinued for safety or effectiveness reasons. Generic tablets are approved.

bullets: **Blocks PDE5,** the main cGMP-breaking enzyme in penile tissue
**Nitric oxide** from sexual stimulation raises cGMP
**Needs sexual stimulation** to work, per the label
17,000+ men in controlled and open trials

practical.halfLife: About 4 to 5 hours (drug and main metabolite)
practical.routes: By mouth (tablets; dissolving tablets now discontinued)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 30 minutes to 2 hours (median 60 minutes); liver (CYP3A4)
practical.monitored: Blood pressure, QT interval, vision and hearing changes

regulatory.text: Approved for ED (2003); brands now discontinued

references: Goldstein et al., Diabetes Care, vardenafil in men with diabetes, Mar 2003
